page.layout: One page of running text in one column; small marginal fragments at the left edge beside the middle lines (not legible enough to read).

main_text.p: urbem accederet: decrevisse enim populum, neminem regum in urbem ad-mittere. Demetrius igitur tacitè secum fremens, sed iram, quia sic præsens fortuna poscebat, strenuè dissimulans, imò benevolentiam præ se ferens, receptâ hoc modo ab Atheniensibus classe sua, quam in portu Piræo habebat, ad Isthmum subitò se contulit, atque ibi comperit, omnes, qui tum in Peloponneso, tum in reliqua Græcia & regionibus aliis, partium ipsius fuerant, nulla vi adactos, ultrò ad hostes deficere. Itaque velut desertus ab omni fortunâ cum desperatione aliquandiu luctatus, tandem recollecto ex consternatione animo in Lysimachum, quem & infensissimum sibi, & ob insignem arrogantiam cæteris regibus invisum esse norat, se movit, ac in Cherronesum Thraciam classem appellens, [illegible, ~4 letters]excensione illic facta, & proximis quibusque vi, metu, suadâ sibi adjunctis, copias haud parvas reparavit. [illegible, ~2 letters]Mox accessit & fortuna alia inopina. Nam Seleucus filiam ejus, quam insigni forma ac morum gratia habebat: ultrò nuptiis expetivit, eaque promptissimâ voluntate parentis accepta, novus gener cum filia Ptolemæi Ægyptii socero con-jugium conciliavit. Qua gemina affi-nitate

page.notes: Two small marginal fragments at the left edge (beside "excensione" and "copias") are unreadable, so they are marked as illegible. Line-end hyphens "ad-", "clas-", "con-" and "affi-" are kept as printed. Long s has been written as s throughout. The printed "decrevifle" and "poscebat" have been read as "decrevisse" and "poscebat". The page ends mid-word ("affi-"), so the text continues on the next page.
